title: Eddie Daniels Blackwood CD 1989 - Jazz, GRP Digital Master
descriptionText: The Blackwood Eddie Daniels CD from 1989 by GRP Records is a digital master edition album in standard jewel case packaging. Produced by Dave Grusin, this jazz CD features a multicolor design and runs for 47 minutes. With English language lyrics, this album is perfect for all occasions and is a must-have for jazz enthusiasts looking to add a classic album to their collection.
